caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow plate with a decorative border around the rim consisting of a dotted pattern in brown. The central composition shows a symmetrical floral arrangement contained within a stylized vase or pot. The vase is decorated with geometric patterns, including triangles and diamond shapes, and sits at the bottom center of the plate. From the vase, several curving stems emerge, each ending in a large flower or leaf. The largest flower, positioned near the top center, has eight elongated petals outlined in brown, filled with a lighter brown shade, and a circular center. On either side of the central flower are two smaller, drooping flowers with multiple petals, also outlined and shaded in brown. Scattered within the design are additional stylized leaves, some filled with green and others outlined in brown. The background color of the plate is a warm beige or light tan, and the overall palette includes shades of brown, green, and beige. The drawing has the name "Robert Stewart" and the number "39" written below the plate.
title: Pa. German Dish
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
